summary: Read-only data & cost critic pass over the three priority tracks and the default evidence guidance. Verdicts: Track A (FX intraday liquidity provision) MEASURABLE_WITH_GAPS - data + measured per-session spread curves sha-pinned, all ten broker cost components UNMEASURED (DATA-EDGE lane F BLOCKED_BROKER_COST_AUTHORITY, stress 2.0 frozen); paper-shadow cost book is sufficient ONLY for paper-tier prospective evidence under five binding conditions (verdict class bounded, structural-zero financing via force-flat fixture, per-session/event-time spread not p50, adverse selection declared unmeasurable, TrueFX marks seam disclosed). Track B (delta-neutral crypto basis/carry) MEASURABLE_WITH_GAPS for funding/basis/klines legs (PIT-usable multi-year; basis empty pre-2019-11; three distinct funding floors must be named) and BLOCKED for borrow (never measured anywhere in repo), margin/liquidation (liquidationSnapshot ZERO coverage 404; no margin engine), historical OI (retrospective-only ~41.6h REST). Analytic carry/cost: RT 20-25 bps vs in-downtrend funding 1.11 bps/day gives breakeven ~18-23 days base, ~27-34 days at 1.5x stress (altcoin band 11-36 days) - viable only at >= ~3-5 week low-turnover holds; XSECT realized 66:1 cost:carry corroborates that weekly churn is structurally unviable; funding-path stress required (24.7% of in-DT settlements negative; worst -0.30% = 2.5 fee RTs). Track C (forced-flow/event premiums) BLOCKED for historical scored use: no crypto flow source is both historical and PIT-authorizable today (liquidation 404/ZERO; OI overwritten; keyless WS 34min << lane C 14-day floors 303/336 + 152/168 STRICT; Coinbase l2_data and Deribit trades keyless-rejected); stocks FTD landed PASS_D2_CONTROL_ONLY (control, not direct signal); Track C children must be prospective-collection-first on the frozen lane C contract floors before any proposal lane. Power analysis vs the review's 52-week/Sharpe-2.0 claim: SE(SR)~1/sqrt(n); n=100 round trips detects per-trade SR 0.20 = PF~1.5 at 50% WR (PF 1.3 needs n~236); fixed-window law SR_annual_min ~ 2/sqrt(T_years) (6m -> 2.83, 1y -> 2.00). Guidance verdicts: 5 keep, 5 keep-with-modification, daily>=100 too loose (implies 3.17 annualized bar, inconsistent with the cited 2.0), H4 '2 volatility regimes' structurally unsatisfiable as scored cells (TWO-REGIME census: all states fail floors 20/3/100). Three most important corrections: (1) make the power law explicit - derived n_floor = ceil((2/SR*)^2) at preregistered SR* plus the fixed-window law, with floor-level <2sigma results recorded INCONCLUSIVE/UNRESOLVED, never PASS/kill; (2) per-track stress laws instead of generic 1.5x fee - FX frozen spread x2.0 on event-time session medians, crypto carry funding-path stress + turnover budget from the >=3-5 week breakeven, H4 x1.5/+2 ticks/+1 event delay, plus a pre-fill cost-law identity pin (6 bps vs 5 bps + 1 tick); (3) bind Track C (and venue-native crypto children) to the frozen lane C coverage floors as a pre-proposal precondition and disclose that current keyless channels exclude the depth-of-book observable the forced-flow thesis needs (owner source-authorization decision).
